DESCRIPTION: Resident reported the AC stopped cooling overnight with the indoor temperature reaching 88 degrees. A toddler and an elderly parent live in the home, so the resident asked for same-day service.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Technician found a failed capacitor and a clogged condensate line. Both were replaced and cleared, cooling was restored within 4 hours of dispatch, and a filter-change reminder was added to the resident portal.

DESCRIPTION: The thermostat shows the system running, but upstairs bedrooms stay roughly 10 degrees warmer than the main floor. The resident says this is the third complaint since June.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The vendor found disconnected supply ductwork in the attic and resealed it. The recurring complaint was flagged for a capital review of the 2004 air handler.

DESCRIPTION: Water is leaking from the ceiling below the upstairs bathroom and has stained the drywall in the living room. The resident shut off the bathroom supply valve but water continued to drip.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The plumber traced the leak to a failed wax ring and a cracked supply line. A water mitigation vendor ran moisture readings and set dehumidifiers, and drywall repair was scheduled after a 72-hour dry-out.

DESCRIPTION: Kitchen sink drains slowly and backs up into the second basin when the dishwasher runs. The resident tried a store-bought drain cleaner with no improvement.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Main kitchen line was snaked and roots were found at the cleanout. The resident was given guidance on avoiding chemical drain cleaners, which damage older PVC joints.

DESCRIPTION: The water heater is producing lukewarm water for only about five minutes during morning showers. The household has five occupants.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Lower heating element and thermostat were replaced on the 40-gallon unit. The technician recommended upsizing to 50 gallons at next turnover given occupancy.

DESCRIPTION: The refrigerator is not keeping food cold and the freezer has begun to thaw. The resident asked whether spoiled groceries would be reimbursed.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Compressor relay replaced same day. The resident was referred to the renter's insurance policy for food loss per the lease addendum, and the case was escalated to the community manager for a courtesy credit decision.

DESCRIPTION: The dishwasher leaves standing water at the bottom after each cycle and has developed a musty odor.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The drain pump filter was clogged with debris and was cleaned. The unit is 11 years old and was tagged for replacement at the next turnover.

DESCRIPTION: Resident reported seeing several roaches in the kitchen and bathroom within one week of move-in. They are concerned the home was not treated before occupancy.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: An interior treatment was applied with a 30-day follow-up. The make-ready checklist for this property showed the pre-move-in pest treatment was skipped, and this was reported to the turnover vendor manager.

DESCRIPTION: Fire ants are mounding along the driveway and in the backyard, where the resident's children play.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: A perimeter and yard granular treatment was applied. The property was added to the quarterly exterior pest program for Florida markets.

DESCRIPTION: Outlets in the garage and one bathroom stopped working, and the resident smelled burning near the electrical panel.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The electrician found a scorched breaker and a loose neutral connection and replaced the breaker. The home was inspected for additional hazards, and a GFCI outlet was installed in the bathroom to meet code.

DESCRIPTION: Two exterior light fixtures do not turn on and the resident is concerned about safety at night.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Fixtures were replaced with LED dusk-to-dawn units, consistent with the portfolio exterior lighting standard.

DESCRIPTION: After a heavy thunderstorm the resident noticed a brown water stain spreading on the bedroom ceiling. Shingles were found in the yard.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The roofer tarped the damaged section within 24 hours and documented hail and wind damage. An insurance claim was opened, and the permanent repair was scheduled pending adjuster review.

DESCRIPTION: The back sliding door is very hard to open and does not lock, which the resident considers a security problem.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Rollers and track were replaced and the lock mechanism was realigned. The resident confirmed the door locks properly.

DESCRIPTION: The HOA sent a violation notice for overgrown grass and dead shrubs in the front yard. The resident says landscaping is supposed to be included in their lease.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The lease was confirmed to include monthly landscaping. The vendor had missed two visits, so service was performed and the HOA violation was resolved before a fine was assessed. A vendor scorecard deduction was logged.

DESCRIPTION: The garage door opener makes a grinding noise and stops halfway when closing.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Drive gear and safety sensors were replaced. The resident received safe-operation instructions.

DESCRIPTION: A washing machine supply hose burst while the resident was at work, flooding the laundry room and hallway with roughly an inch of standing water.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Extraction and drying equipment ran for 3 days. Laminate flooring in the hallway was removed and replaced. Braided steel supply hoses were installed and the portfolio standard was updated to require them.

DESCRIPTION: The resident disputes a $185 utility reimbursement charge and says the water bill shows usage while the home was vacant before move-in.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The utility ledger confirmed the charge covered days before the lease start date. The charge was reversed, and the move-in utility transfer process was reviewed with the leasing team.

DESCRIPTION: The resident received a late fee even though the rent payment was submitted through the portal on the 1st. The bank shows the payment as pending.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The payment processor reported a settlement delay affecting 37 residents. Late fees were waived in bulk and a portal notification was sent.

DESCRIPTION: The resident received a renewal offer with a 7.5% increase and asked why it is higher than their neighbor's, who renewed at 4%.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Revenue management explained that the renewal price reflects comparable listings for the home's size and finishes. A 12-month renewal at 5.25% was offered as a retention concession, and the resident accepted.

DESCRIPTION: The resident is relocating for work and asked about options to end their lease 4 months early without penalty.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The early-termination policy was explained (60-day notice plus one month's rent), along with the option to transfer to a home in another market with no fee. The resident chose to transfer to the Nashville market.

DESCRIPTION: Heat pump is blowing cold air on the heat setting and the auxiliary heat light stays on. Overnight lows are in the 30s.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: A reversing valve solenoid was replaced. The technician noted the outdoor unit was undersized for the square footage and flagged it for replacement planning.

DESCRIPTION: The toilet in the hall bathroom runs continuously, and the resident is worried about their water bill.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Flapper and fill valve replaced. A leak-detection sensor was offered and installed under the smart-home program.

DESCRIPTION: The smart lock keypad stopped accepting the resident's code and they had to use the physical key.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Batteries were replaced and the lock was re-paired with the hub. Codes were re-provisioned remotely through the smart home platform.

DESCRIPTION: The resident cannot connect the smart thermostat to their new Wi-Fi and the schedule has reset to default.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Remote support walked the resident through re-pairing. The help article for Wi-Fi changes was updated because it is the most common smart-home ticket.

DESCRIPTION: The resident sees black spotting on the bathroom ceiling and around the window frame and is worried about health effects for their child with asthma.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: An inspector found surface mold from poor ventilation; the exhaust fan was not venting outside. The fan was re-ducted to the exterior, a remediation vendor treated the area, and the resident was offered temporary lodging per the moisture policy.

DESCRIPTION: The oven takes over 40 minutes to preheat and the bake element visibly glows unevenly.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Bake element replaced; oven temperature calibration verified.

DESCRIPTION: The new resident reported carpet stains in two bedrooms, a missing blind in the kitchen, and nail holes that were not patched after move-in.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The move-in inspection photos confirmed the items were missed during make-ready. The turnover vendor returned within 48 hours at no cost, and the QA sign-off step was reinforced for the Atlanta market.

DESCRIPTION: The resident moved in to find the HVAC filter missing, no water in the water heater, and the dishwasher still disconnected.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Same-day dispatch resolved all items and the resident received a $150 move-in credit. Root cause was a skipped utility activation checklist, which has been added to the make-ready QA form.

DESCRIPTION: Sewage is backing up into the downstairs shower and tub, and the home has a strong odor.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The main sewer line was cleared, and a camera inspection found a collapsed section of clay pipe. A line replacement was approved as a capital repair and the resident was moved to a hotel for 2 nights.

DESCRIPTION: The resident asked whether the air filter should be replaced, as none has been changed in 6 months.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Filter delivery subscription was confirmed active but packages were going to the previous resident's address. The address was corrected and the filter was replaced during a courtesy visit.

DESCRIPTION: The resident received an HOA notice that trash bins are visible from the street, which is not allowed in the community.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Guidance on HOA rules was provided and the community welcome packet was updated for build-to-rent communities.

DESCRIPTION: The ceiling fan in the primary bedroom wobbles badly and the light flickers.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The fan mounting box was not fan-rated. A rated box was installed and the fan rebalanced.

DESCRIPTION: The resident noticed granules accumulating in the downspouts and a few curled shingles visible from the yard.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The roof inspection estimated 3-5 years of remaining life. The property was added to the capital plan for roof replacement in 2027.

DESCRIPTION: The fence gate is broken and the resident's dog escaped twice this week.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Gate hinges and latch were replaced. Fence condition was noted as fair, with a replacement estimate filed.

DESCRIPTION: The resident hears scratching in the attic at night and found droppings in the garage.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: A wildlife vendor identified roof rats and sealed entry points at soffits and roof vents. Traps were set and the property was scheduled for a 2-week follow-up.

DESCRIPTION: The resident's renewal deadline is in 5 days and they have not received a renewal offer through the portal.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: An automated renewal workflow failure was found for 12 leases in the Phoenix market. Offers were generated manually and the integration error was logged for the systems team.

DESCRIPTION: The resident asked why their move-out security deposit disposition deducted $640 for paint when they lived in the home for 4 years.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The deduction was reviewed against the normal wear-and-tear policy. Paint after 4 years of occupancy is normal wear, so $640 was refunded.

DESCRIPTION: The resident found the carpet wet along the wall shared by the water heater closet.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The water heater tank had begun leaking at 13 years old and was replaced. A drain pan and leak sensor were installed and the carpet pad was replaced.

DESCRIPTION: A window in the child's bedroom will not latch after a storm and the screen is torn.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: The window sash was realigned, the latch replaced, and the screen rescreened. A window-safety check was completed.

DESCRIPTION: The resident noticed condensation dripping from the air vents and a damp smell in the hallway.
RESOLUTION_NOTES: Vent boots were insulated in the attic and the HVAC drain line was cleared. Humidity readings returned to normal on follow-up.
